description: Check the authentication of an email and of a domain's mail records: paste the raw headers of a message (Authentication-Results, DKIM-Signature, From, Reply-To, Return-Path) and/or the DNS TXT records (v=spf1, v=DMARC1, v=DKIM1). Finds SPF/DKIM/DMARC failures, a Reply-To or Return-Path on another domain, a DKIM signature that does not cover From or only part of the body (l=), weak or revoked keys, SPF +all / ?all / more than 10 DNS lookups, and DMARC p=none or without reports. Verifies DKIM key strength locally; it does NOT query DNS — paste the records you want checked.

input.description: Raw message headers, DNS TXT records, or both

name: email_auth_audit
